alert_force-mode-unrecoverable: Force mode allows to update the pipeline while it is in "Paused" state. It is an unsafe action, especially when the pipeline topology is being changed. This may potentially leave the pipeline in an unrecoverable state.
for-more-details-1: For more details about force mode updates, refer to
alert_override-state-unavailable: This controller does not support override provenance. The effective specification remains available for viewing and editing.
context_override-intent: Patches are applied in order. A map patch can cover earlier nested patches without deleting them; canceling it restores their effect. Inherited entries follow the current base.
context_runtime-target-state: Runtime target state: {{state}}. Pipeline lifecycle controls this field separately from user overrides.
error_unsafe-version: Cannot read the dynamic specification: the controller returned a version that cannot be represented exactly.
context_cancel-patch: Cancel all remaining changes from this patch
context_update-patch: Update the value or comment of this patch
context_sparse-edit: Change one parameter at a time. Only that parameter will be overridden. Click a map in Patches to replace a map; use Cancel to cancel its changes.
context_replace-map: This action replaces the selected map in the effective specification. Earlier nested patches remain in history and take effect again if this map patch is canceled. Omitted base keys are hidden while it is active.
error_sparse-edit: Change one parameter at a time. No changes were saved. Click a map in Patches to explicitly replace a map; use Cancel to cancel its changes.
context_map-inherited-fields: This map currently inherits some fields from the base. Replacing the whole map stops inheriting those fields. Include them explicitly to keep their current values.
context_comment-required: Add a comment explaining the change.
context_value-change-required: Change the specification to save an update.
context_patch-change-required: Change the value or comment to save an update.
error_inconsistent-version: The dynamic specification changed while loading. Refresh to try again.
